outline:
翻譯各式文體風格之文章，賞析名家之譯作，涵括文學、科學、教育、商業等領域作品，並佐以特殊表現法及修辭法之認識及練習。
This course aims at an appreciation of various styles of translated works in such fields as literature, education, science & technology, commerce. so as to equip students with a deep insight into the usage of rhetoric and expression for particular purpose.
schedule:
Week 1: Don't Get Lost in Translation
Week 2: The Bible Without Babel
Week 3: Beowulf vs Yuan Qu
Week 4: Canterbury Tales
Week 5: William Shakespeare
Week 6: Exercises de style
Week 7: Moby-Dick
Week 8: W. B. Yeats
Week 9: Midterm
Week 10: The Great Gatsby
Week 11: Virginia Woolf
Week 12: Translating the “Unconscious” of Women in Love
Week 13: James Joyce
Week 14: A Clockwork Orange
Week 15: Trainspotting
Week 16: Samuel Beckett
Week 17: Tangut Inn
Week 18: Final
